mechanism: Cenobamate inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing sodium valproate levels, while valproate may inhibit cenobamate metabolism, leading to elevated concentrations of both drugs and increased risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor valproate and cenobamate serum concentrations closely; consider dose reduction of valproate when initiating cenobamate; monitor for signs of valproate toxicity (tremor, ataxia, hepatotoxicity) and cenobamate adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia).
